cues: In egg-free baking, mashed ripe fruit binds muffin batter and adds moisture, helping cakes stay tender without eggs.
Green-stage flesh contains resistant starch, which gut microbes ferment and may help support a balanced intestinal microbiome.
Gardeners compost discarded skins from a soft, sweet tropical fruit, returning organic matter and minerals to the soil.
At South Asian feasts, broad leaves from a towering tropical herb serve as compostable plates for curries and rice.
Researchers test starch from unripe fruit as a feedstock for biodegradable films that could replace some plastic packaging.
In Southeast Asian cooking, sliced flower buds from a tropical fruiting herb add mild bitterness to curries and salads.
